scripts.dev: npm run compile && wait-on http://localhost:5173 && wait-on http://localhost:3001/api/v1/health && node ../../scripts/start-electron-dev.cjs
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run stage:runtime && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.build:win: node ../../scripts/check-windows-runtime.cjs && npm run compile && npm run stage:runtime && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.build:linux: npm run compile && npm run stage:runtime && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.pack: npm run compile && npm run stage:runtime && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.build:pilot: node ../../scripts/check-windows-runtime.cjs && npm run compile && npm run stage:runtime && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.pilot.yml --publish never
